title: Northwestern Athletics and Under Armour Announce Landmark 10-Year Partnership Extension Through 2037
summary: Northwestern University Athletics and Under Armour (NYSE: UA) today announced a landmark 10-year extension of their apparel and equipment partnership, keeping the Wildcats outfitted by the Baltimore-based global performance brand through at least 2037. The agreement extends the current contract set to expire in 2027 and represents the most comprehensive and forward-looking apparel partnership in Northwestern Athletics history.
body_markdown:
### **Partnership Highlights**


**Specialty & Innovative Uniform Design** — Under Armour commits to an elevated, thoughtful approach to uniform design, collaborating directly with Northwestern student-athletes to develop specialty and alternate jersey packages for marquee contests across key programs. Student-athletes will have a meaningful voice in creating the designs that resonate on the field and in the stands, building on the program’s distinctive identity as a top 10 academic institution competing in one of the most elite athletic conferences.


**Expanded NIL Flexibility** — The agreement includes significant Name, Image, and Likeness initiatives, unlocking new opportunities for Northwestern student-athletes to partner with Under Armour, leverage the brand’s global platform, and gain hands-on experience alongside UA’s innovation and design teams.


**Increased Marketing Investment** — Under Armour will meaningfully increase its annual marketing support for Northwestern Athletics, including co-branded campaigns, digital content, and high-visibility promotional activations that amplify the ‘Cats national profile.


**Broader Retail Presence** — Under Armour is committed to a curated and expanded retail footprint, ensuring fans have access to premium Northwestern-branded Under Armour product that reflects the quality and character of the Wildcats’ brand — both locally in Chicago and nationally.


**World-Class Performance Equipment & Apparel** — All 21 of Northwestern’s varsity programs will receive best-in-class performance gear with enhanced allocations, ensuring every Wildcat trains and competes in Under Armour’s most innovative footwear and apparel and uses elite equipment — the same technology trusted by top athletes across the globe.
